neighbours.label: The determiner 'any' introducing an unrestricted class of people or things.
fire: The policy applies to any visitor entering the building.
You may select any folder from the menu.
We will review any complaint submitted before Friday.
The guide can answer any question about the exhibit.
Please report any error found in the document.
The offer is available to any resident of the town.
They will accept any proposal that meets the requirements.
The rule covers any vehicle parked near the entrance.
